all.src: Alpaca options level >= 3 (defined risk; no naked leg) - allowed on the paper account
Net credit >= 33% of the wing width W (e.g. >= $1.65 on a $5 wing); reject the trade otherwise
Short strikes at 0.14-0.20 delta on both sides; if the chain has no strike in that band, take the nearest strike with delta <= 0.20
Short strikes at 0.14-0.20 delta on both sides; if the chain has no strike in that band, take the nearest strike with delta <= 0.20
No earnings report, ex-dividend date, or scheduled FOMC/CPI inside the expiry window
Per-leg liquidity: open interest >= 500, day volume >= 100, bid-ask spread <= 10% of leg mid or <= $0.10, whichever is larger
Per-leg liquidity: open interest >= 500, day volume >= 100, bid-ask spread <= 10% of leg mid or <= $0.10, whichever is larger
Per-leg liquidity: open interest >= 500, day volume >= 100, bid-ask spread <= 10% of leg mid or <= $0.10, whichever is larger
Position size: max loss of the structure <= 2% of account equity ($1,000 on $50k); total short-premium buying power across all open structures <= 35% of equity

management.src: Take profit: close the entire structure at 50% of the credit received (buy back for <= 0.50 x credit)
Time stop: close at 21 DTE regardless of P/L (tastytrade SPY study: managing at 50%/21 DTE raised win rate and cut time in trade)
Loss stop: close if the structure can only be bought back for >= 2.0x the credit received (i.e. -100% of credit as loss, roughly 2x credit debit)

Tested-side roll: if either short strike's |delta| >= 0.30, roll the untested side's spread toward the money to a 0.25-0.30 delta short, same expiry, for additional credit - only once per trade, and only if DTE > 21
If IV rank falls below 15 while the trade is profitable, take profit early (the vega edge is gone)

exits.src: HARD ASSIGNMENT GUARD: submit a closing order for the entire structure no later than 15:45 ET on expiration day, regardless of P/L, even if both shorts are OTM. Nothing with a short leg is ever held to settlement.
Close immediately (market-adjacent marketable limit) if any short strike goes ITM by more than 0.25 x W, or a short leg's delta >= 0.85, or a short leg's extrinsic value < $0.10
Close immediately (market-adjacent marketable limit) if any short strike goes ITM by more than 0.25 x W, or a short leg's delta >= 0.85, or a short leg's extrinsic value < $0.10
Close immediately (market-adjacent marketable limit) if any short strike goes ITM by more than 0.25 x W, or a short leg's delta >= 0.85, or a short leg's extrinsic value < $0.10
Dividend guard: if the short call's extrinsic value < the projected dividend amount, close or roll that call spread before the close of the session preceding the ex-dividend date
Pin guard on expiration day: if the underlying is within 0.30% of either short strike at 15:30 ET, close immediately rather than waiting for 15:45
If any leg becomes untradeable (no bid, halted underlying), close the remaining tradeable legs that carry short risk first, then flatten the longs
